title: Spawn Filter Test
description: A single filter condition used to test entity or world properties. Filters check things like biome type, weather, time of day, or entity attributes. Multiple filters can be combined with all_of, any_of, and none_of operators.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.
